decisions.statement: A terminal reporting no process is left as that terminal is.
A terminal that never reported a process is given one fixed name.
A terminal is renamed only where the name that terminal has differs.
A terminal is recolored only where the color that terminal has differs.
A terminal is given the color its caller worked out rather than finding a color.
A terminal with no color to give has its color cleared once.
A terminal whose seat is gone is renamed for the shell running in that terminal.
A terminal whose shell is no longer running keeps the name and the color that terminal has.
A reset says whether the seat went or the terminal answered at last.
Every rename and recolor is said on the channel handed in.
Nothing here reads a seat page.

definition: the name and the color a terminal is given for the seat in it
